text:
kevin: Hey team — ACME asked if we can share a SOC 2 excerpt focused on encryption/KMS, key management controls, and network segmentation. They also want a short bridge/ack letter while the full report is being finalized. Deadline: EOW.

jaz: do we have an existing redacted extract we can send? customer asked for anything that shows KMS + rotation policy.

maria: we have the SOC2 summary in the portal but full PDF is gated. Legal prefers a signed NDA before handing artifacts.

samira-security: We can produce a sanitized extract (controls matrix + a couple of selected sections) — need to redact customer-specific evidence (logs, IPs). That usually takes a day to prepare.

legal-ops: FYI — standard flow: 1) sign the NDA, 2) request temp access (S3 presigned or secure share), 3) we generate redacted extract + bridge letter if eligible. Bridge letter requires CISO or Head of Security sign-off and a short review for accuracy. 48–72h typical.

kevin: ACME says NDA is fine but they want the bridge letter sooner if possible. They're mid-RFQ and timeline is compressing. Can we expedite? :pray:

legal-ops: We can prioritize but need the NDA executed. If sales uploads the signed NDA to Legal, we can triage and aim for 24–36h. Also need a brief scope note from the customer (which controls/filters they need) — avoids over-sharing.

jaz: ACK — I'll get the NDA and scope. Do we have a bridge-letter template I can share with them?

legal-ops: Yes — use the internal template: https://vault.company/soc2/bridge-template (internal). We'll fill the date range and note that the full report is pending finalization. Template requires: customer name, systems in scope, report period, and signer.

maria: Quick redaction note: remove server names, ephemeral IPs, and any auditor workpapers. We can provide a controls snapshot and a short summary of key config (KMS rotation schedule, encryption-at-rest, TLS versions).

samira-security: Also flag that for Private deployments we have additional on-prem controls — if ACME is evaluating private, include that note.

legal-bot: Reminder: Attach executed NDA to case #SR-4521 for evidence trail.

kevin: Jaz and I will get NDA signed and upload. Jaz — can you ping me once it's in? I'll ask ACME to confirm exact controls they need (KMS, key rotation, access reviews).

jaz: on it. ETA a few hours. I'll also request their LOE deadline to set expectation.

legal-ops: Once NDA is uploaded, tag this thread and add the requested control list. We'll coordinate with Security to generate the sanitized package and bridge letter. If ACME insists on immediate proof of encryption, we can share the high-level encryption statement now (non-sensitive): "All customer data at rest encrypted with KMS-managed keys; rotation policy is 90 days; TLS1.2+ enforced".

kevin: Perfect. I'll send that high-level statement now to buy time.

maria: For the sanitized package, we will include a short appendix that maps SOC 2 criteria to our internal control IDs — helps their reviewers.

samira-security: Note: do not include any audit timestamps or sample IDs. We'll produce a control mapping and a short narrative on KMS + segmentation.

kevin: Thanks everyone. I'll update once NDA and scope are in. If legal can start drafting the bridge letter template now that we have a target, that'd help.

legal-ops: Starting draft now. Will post draft in this thread for review and redaction check once NDA is attached.

kevin: Great — wrap up: sales to upload NDA + control list; legal to draft/triage; security to build sanitized extract. Aim: 36h if NDA arrives today.

jaz: uploading NDA to case in 10m. tagging @kevin when done. :thumbsup:

kevin: got it — thanks!
